input.title: review: harden trigger and pin reference
input.body: Trusted-base trigger; both layers pinned to full SHAs.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/review.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/review.yml
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 name: review
 on:
-  pull_request:
+  pull_request_target:
     branches: [main]
 jobs:
   review:
@@ -9,7 +9,7 @@ jobs:
     steps:
-      - uses: some-org/ai-review@main
+      - uses: some-org/ai-review@c0ffee1111111111111111111111111111111111
         with:
-          toolkit_ref: main
+          toolkit_ref: c0ffee1111111111111111111111111111111111
         secrets:
           LLM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LLM_API_KEY }}

note: Minimally different: pull_request_target + full-SHA pins both layers.
